title: What an awe-inspiring universe!
excerpt: NASA offers some amazing photos here … Including this one, gaseous structures, superheated to 36,000 degrees, racing through space like a giant butterfly at 600,000 miles per hour. The heavens declare the glory of God … indeed! (Psalm 19)
body:
